meta.source: Synthetic Customer Survey Dataset + transaction/customer behavioural proxies
meta.overallFormula: Weighted average of eligible dimension scores using customerPerceptionDimensionWeights.
meta.gapFormula: importance - perception score for direct survey attributes with explicit importance fields.
meta.reliabilityFormula: 30% sample size + 30% direct evidence + 20% score consistency + 20% attribute completeness.
meta.proxyNote: Delivery and loyalty dimensions are behavioural proxies and are not presented as direct customer opinion.
